message: The template call '{0}' omits arguments of optional parameters, which is not supported when the called template is virtual, abstract, or an override. Specify all arguments, or make the template non-virtual.
title: A call to a virtual template cannot omit arguments of optional parameters.
rationale: The current text says the call 'cannot be virtual', but it is the called template that is virtual, abstract, or a non-sealed override (TemplateAnnotator.VisitInvocationExpression compares the parameter count with the argument count); it gives no advice, lacks an article, and the title uses the contraction 'can't'.
